rows.en: Heh heh heh heh... I am the great Nega Den-O. My strength is in a league of its own.
...He's way too strong. I can't even fight back...!
We're no match for him... What the hell are we supposed to do?
Take that, and that, and THAAAT!!! Got it through your heads yet!!
This is my true power!! Heh heh heh, hahahaha!!!
Hey! Negataros!! Now that I'm here, you ain't gettin' your way anymore.
You Imagin...!? Hmph! You guys just don't quit.
And we'll be taking back that spare Pass, too.
Let me have a turn later~!!
Momotaros took out the Rider Pass and held it up to the belt!
Lemme tell ya... I'm at my climax right from the start!!
Don't make me laugh! Get him, you lot!
Here I go, here I go, here I gooo!!
As a greeting, I'll show you my best move right off the bat! Here goes! "My Special Attack, Part 1"!!
All right, who's next!? C'mon, bring it ooon!!
Sempai, it's not fair you get all the fun!!
Don't just swap in on your own!!
Cheeky little trick!! Doesn't matter, make a bloody example of him!!
Hey you, how about you let me reel you in?
Right then, reckon it's my turn.
My strength made ya cry. Wipe yer tears with this.
I've heard enough outta you!! What're you lot doin'!? Hurry up and finish 'em off!!
You're gonna change forms again!? Like hell I'll let you!! Go!!
I'm gonna beat you, okay? I don't care about your answer!!
Aww, that was over way too fast.
Tch! Guess I'll regroup... My evil organization will never lose, you hear me!!
Ah! Hey! Get back here, damn it!!
Heh heh heh, hahaha!! The idiots came back!!
Heh heh heh heh heh!! It seems this time you truly wish to die.

notes.note: Negataros's transformation cry kept as the franchise term 'Henshin' (no earlier precedent in finished slices); the reactions that follow use plain 'transformed'.

Rows 0.15-0.20 are party-leader variants of one reaction; each worded to the character (Philip emphatic, Nu Gundam incredulous, Zeta defiant, Zero exasperated). Subject 'he' = Negataros (glossary g=m).
Subject restored: 'He' (Nega Den-O) is too strong; 'I' can't fight back.
Zero: dropped subjects restored as 'we'/'him' (whole party vs Nega Den-O).
'Ora ora ora' battle yell rendered as 'Take that, and that, and THAAAT!!!'.
Kintaros's nickname for Momotaros (Momo + suffix used for a name) rendered as plain 'Momo'; Kansai dialect shown with clipped 'im/ya'.
Ryutaros asking Momotaros to swap the body over to him afterwards.
Narration; 'the belt' (no possessor in source; Den-O belt normally Ryotaro's).
Den-O Belt voice lines (Sword/Rod/Ax/Gun Form) in caps and double quotes per glossary style for driver voice lines.
Momotaros catchphrase ('I'm at my climax right from the start'); not in glossary catchphrase list.
'You lot' = Nega Den-O's minions (Bat Man etc. attack next).
Kaijin roars (Bat Man, Mantis Man, T-Rex Dopant) have no precedent in finished slices (story_014 not yet translated): romanized/onomatopoeic. Check against story_014 for consistency.
Momotaros's named finisher rendered 'My Special Attack Part 1' in quotes.
Urataros to Momotaros; he then forcibly takes over the body (Rod Form).
Urataros catchphrase (fishing pun) rendered 'how about you let me reel you in?'.
'Kin-chan' = Urataros's nickname for Kintaros, kept romanized (also 0.75).
Kintaros catchphrase line (he hands over tissues): 'My strength made ya cry. Wipe yer tears with this.'
'Finish 'em off' object inferred as the Den-O/Imagin side; 'you lot' = minions.
Kintaros announces his finisher name after the hit: 'Dynamic Chop' (canon name).
Ryutaros catchphrase per glossary: 'I don't care about your answer!!'
Kintaros calls Urataros 'Kame' (Turtle, matching Momotaros's 'Turtle' in story_010/011) and Ryutaros 'Ryuta'.

Scene change (MainEventMess0146): plural 'idiots' assumed = the hero party returning to face Nega Den-O and Weather Dopant (Weather's next line 'this time you truly wish to die' addresses a group). Could also be singular.
Weather Dopant's attack grunt (exertion), not a scoff.
proofread: finisher name to glossary form 'My Special Attack, Part 1' (comma).
proofread: T-Rex Dopant roar to glossary style.roars spelling 'Gwaaaargh!!' (matches story_014).

report: 80/80 rows examined. Uncertain: 0146.1 plural 'idiots' inferred; kaijin roars have no precedent yet (story_014 untranslated). Not in glossary: Henshin, Nega Den-O lines' 'the great' (matches earlier 'the great Negataros'), Kin-chan, Momo, Ryuta, Turtle, Dynamic Chop, 'My Special Attack Part 1', Den-O belt calls SWORD/ROD/AX/GUN FORM, 'climax right from the start' catchphrase.
